summary: Implemented timestamp-first goal run branch naming with UTC prefix (`claw/run/YYYYMMDD-HHMMSSZ-<runId>`), added `buildRunBranchName`, and threaded a single resolved branch name through executor checkout/push/PR paths. Goal command now passes run `createdAt` into executor metadata so initial execution and resume share the same timestamp source. Updated git-checkpoint tests to assert the new format and branch usage in push/PR calls. Verification run: `pnpm build`, `pnpm vitest run src/goal/`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, plus CLI flow `node scripts/run-node.mjs goal resume ... --json` (in this sandbox the Node runtime reports `canRunGit=false`, so CLI checkpoint path blocks before branch checkout).
